category_title: Credit recovery students with self-discipline and engagement challenges
scenario_title: Self-pacing through modular units with time management struggles
minimal_context: The student is working on an online credit recovery course during the summer session and needs to complete a modular unit assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the online credit recovery course and complete the next modular unit assessment to see if you need to redo the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I haven't started it yet. I thought I could work on it any time I wanted since it's just a single course in the summer.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still need to complete the modules. When will you do it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'll get to it eventually. I like that I can take my time and self-pace through the material so there's less stress.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The assignments still need to be turned in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I didn't do the homework. I didn't study for test. Well the number one reason I didn't pass the course is because I was a lazy kid, and I'm still not turning in my assignments.

task.learning_goal: Materials could be reviewed until mastery was achieved
